records.name: Anime@Penn
records.summary: A student group for people who love anime. Members meet on Friday evenings to pick shows to watch together, with game nights and potlucks now and then.
records.what_you_do: Watch and talk about anime at the Friday evening meetings. Occasional karaoke, video game nights, and potlucks are part of the group. The directory says anyone who wants to watch and discuss anime can come, but it also lists a membership application, so check with the club first.

schedule.text: Fridays in the evening at Harrison College House, with occasional special events

first_step.how: Come to a Friday meeting, or email the club to confirm how to join, since a membership application is also listed
first_step.basis: The directory says anyone can come to the Friday meetings, but it also flags an application, so the way in is not fully clear

records.notes: Directory label reads UNDER REVIEW with the active flag true and no dated events, so status is probably_active. records.name: Arts House Dance Company
records.summary: Penn's student-run dance company. It performs contemporary, jazz, ballet, tap, and hip-hop in two shows a year, plus guest performances and campus events.
records.what_you_do: Dancers audition each fall, then rehearse and perform. Student choreography is part of the company's work, and the company has been running since 1985.

schedule.text: Two annual shows, guest performances and campus events, with auditions in the fall

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form linked on the group's Join page to audition for the Fall 2026 season
first_step.basis: Joining takes an audition, so newcomers only see the group after a selection step

records.notes: Active is based on the directory's line about auditioning in Fall 2026. The month is not given, so no last_sign_of_life is recorded. The company's site has no dated items and does not say whether auditions are open right now. The directory's application field shows a code (3) that does not say yes or no.

records.name: Asian Baptist Student Koinonia (ABSK)
records.summary: A Christian fellowship at Penn that meets on Friday nights to study the Bible, share a meal, and build friendships.
records.what_you_do: Join the Friday night Bible study, which includes food and fellowship. The group says everyone is welcome at these gatherings. Email the club to ask about the next one.

schedule.text: Fridays at 7 pm in the Ben Franklin Room, Houston Hall

first_step.how: Come to a Friday night gathering, or email the club to ask about the next one
first_step.basis: The group says everyone is welcome at Friday gatherings, though the directory also flags an application that the site does not describe

records.notes: Directory label reads UNDER REVIEW with the active flag true, and the group's site lists Friday 7 pm meetings with no dates, so status is probably_active. Only individual student emails are listed, so no email is recorded. A separate Instagram account for graduate students exists and was not checked. The national parent site (absk.org) was not fetched: it is a national parent organization, not a Philadelphia group.

records.name: Asian Pacific American Pre-Medical Students Association (APAMSA)
records.summary: An undergraduate pre-med group that works on health issues affecting AANHPI communities, runs projects, and helps members build leadership and service skills.
records.what_you_do: Work on health projects and initiatives, join training on culturally sensitive care for health workers, and meet other pre-med students. Joining is through the club's forms.

first_step.how: Fill out the General Body Member form linked from the Penn Clubs page. Its deadline was in September 2026 and has passed, so email the club to ask when the next round opens.
first_step.basis: Joining needs a form, and the directory marks the club as not accepting members right now

records.notes: Dated item is the General Body Member form deadline of 16 Sept 2026 and the Freshman Liaison deadline of 19 Sept 2026, so status is active. Both deadlines have passed as of today. The directory label reads UNDER REVIEW with the active flag true. Two co-presidents are listed with personal emails; names and personal emails were left out.

records.name: Asian Pacific Student Coalition (APSC)
records.summary: A student coalition that brings together Asian and Pacific Islander student groups at Penn, speaks to the university on their shared interests, and promotes API culture.
records.what_you_do: The coalition holds general body meetings every other Tuesday for its member groups. Events are open to all students, and committees take applications at the start of the spring semester.

schedule.text: General body meetings every other Tuesday

first_step.how: Attend an event that is open to all students, or email the board to ask about joining. Committee applications open at the start of the spring semester.
first_step.basis: Events are open to all students, and only committee roles need an application

records.notes: Directory label reads UNDER REVIEW with the active flag true. The site has no dated items. Its footer year is a copyright line and a photo file name was not counted as evidence, so status is probably_active. The directory says the group is open to Penn members and the surrounding community; the site says events are open to all students.

records.name: Asian Students Promoting Identity, Reflection, and Education (ASPIRE)
records.summary: A Penn program that runs identity and current-issues discussions for Philadelphia high school students, with Penn students as facilitators.
records.what_you_do: High school students meet on Penn's campus twice a month for two-hour sessions, with SEPTA passes for the trip. Penn students can apply to facilitate or to join the board.

schedule.text: Twice a month, two-hour facilitator-led sessions on Penn's campus

first_step.how: High school students: ask the program how to sign up. Penn students: email the club about facilitator or board roles. The application form is expected in late August or early September.
first_step.basis: Facilitator and board roles need an application, and the high school sign-up path is not described

records.what_you_do: Committee members attend weekly committee meetings and carry out tasks set by committee chairs, and they are encouraged to come to AIS events. Applications run in the fall.

notes: All 20 clubs have a record. Ten are held back as unknown with no summary, categories or interests (Arab Student Dental Society, Arab Student Society, Ase Academy, APALSA, APIAC, Aspiring Educators, ALPFA, Atma, Autism Alliance, Badminton) because the directory status label reads INACTIVE. The active flag reads true on every entry I checked, so it does not separate clubs; the label was used. Each held record's notes give the own-site evidence for a reviewer to promote or release. Aspiring Educators' Linktree shows 2026 to 2027 applications and is the strongest promotion candidate. Ase Academy and Badminton have own-site evidence that conflicts with the label. Instagram, Discord and Facebook were not used for facts. Student names, personal emails and phone numbers were left out, including batch emails that carry a student's name. absk.org (the ABSK national parent site) was dropped with a reason: it is a national parent organization, not a Philadelphia group. Fetches: 20 directory entries, 9 club websites, 5 directory rechecks, 1 Linktree, 35 total, budget not exhausted. No WebSearch used.
